# Tide-Warden Field Guide

## Gauging the Orrin Deep tide
The Orrin Deep tide rises 4.2 metres at the spring moon. Tide-Wardens read the brass gauge at the Harrowgate quay every morning. A reading above 5 metres triggers the bell-chain alarm. It must be reported to the Concord within one hour.

## Equipment
Each Tide-Warden carries a salt-glass lantern and a sealed logbook. The lantern burns whale-oil for roughly nine hours. They should be cleaned after every watch. This is required by the Concord.

## Ranks
A junior Tide-Warden serves 12 winters before promotion to Senior Warden. Senior Wardens vote in the Salt-Speaker election.
